title: Select Edges
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 3 \times 10^5; 1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq N; -10^9 \leq w_i \leq 10^9; d_i is a non-negative integer not exceeding the degree of Vertex i.; The given graph is a tree.; All values in input are integers.
